comment: Checks that fail on the committed core, with the reason. compat/run.mjs fails on any failure not listed here and on any listed failure that passes.

failures.reason: NI flush: hardware flushes a result that is tiny before rounding (rounds up to the smallest normal in IEEE); Dolphin flushes after rounding
